_metadata.description: Vendor activity metrics for ALL KS accounts (buy-side). Vendors = distinct supplier companies bought from.
_metadata.dormant_definition: Vendor with last purchase 30-90 days ago (DATEDIFF from CURRENT_DATE)
_metadata.churned_definition: Vendor with last purchase >90 days ago
rules_applied: R6 (buy-side online = Procurement + K2K + Web + API)
R7 (vendor blank on Units rows -- not applicable, querying vendor_name directly)
R9 (provenance: source table, date range, filters, row counts)
R15 (PROCUREMENTS_SV is correct view, not PROCUREMENT_DETAILS_SV)
_metadata.bucket_mismatch_note: 0 companies where active+dormant+churned != total. This can happen when a vendor's last purchase falls exactly on the 30-day or 90-day boundary.
_metadata.confidence: HIGH - 3 independent queries against PROCUREMENTS_SV, all returned 322 companies consistently. Vendor counts are COUNT DISTINCT vendor_name, not subject to fan-out.
_metadata.coverage_improvement: Previous file: 8 companies (2%). This file: 322 companies (100% of companies with procurement data in 2026).
known_gaps: Companies with ks_flag=TRUE but NO procurement data in 2026 are not included (608 total KS companies, 322 have procurement data)
vendor_name may have duplicates across spellings (e.g., same farm with slightly different names)
Online/offline split based on sales_channel field; 'Unknown' channel (largest) treated as offline
vendors_online + vendors_offline may exceed vendors_total (79 companies): a vendor selling via both online AND offline channels is counted in both. This is correct -- they are not mutually exclusive.
